name: Dr. Umah
qaNote: Portrait inspected. Preserve green patterned dashiki, locs, gold glasses, ankh and Africa book emblem. Fire and stone constructs are original folded-paper effects. Review green garment chroma integrity, book scale, title and sound.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Dr. Umah — Group Project.
IDENTITY: the exact broad-built Black scholar with short upright locs, black goatee, large gold rectangular glasses, green dashiki with red-yellow-black geometric trim, gold beads and ankh pendant, loose black trousers and green/gold/black sneakers. His black hardback book has the reference's gold Africa silhouette. Keep that emblem, no crowns, no new written book text. No speech.
0–1.2s: establish his complete body and book against pure cyan. He adjusts his glasses, gives a stern "pay attention" look, then snaps the book open with both hands.
1.2–3.2s: the book unfolds into an IMPOSSIBLY enormous pop-up sculpture; camera rockets backward and upward to reveal two paper constructs twenty feet apart above him. One is a red-orange folded-paper bird blazing with outlined amber fire, the other a cream-and-charcoal folded-paper ram carrying floating stone facets. They are visibly made from angular book pages with distinct elements, never additional human characters. He directs each with a sharp conductor-like hand gesture as their paper bases extend from the book, cyan visible between every structure.
3.2–4.8s: both constructs launch in a sweeping spiral past him, the fire bird wrapping around the stone ram until they unite into one colossal flaming stone-and-paper battering ram. Camera races beside the combined creature as it surges thirty feet into depth and SLAMS into a finite suspended black-and-gold target disc. Huge red-orange starburst with flying cream folded-paper shards, a hard contact hold, then an explosive recoil. This is the dominant payoff; no scenery, planet, ground or fullscreen explosion.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back to the scholar as he closes the book with a thunderous CLAP, instantly folding the distant constructs back into its pages. Exact title GROUP PROJECT slams in two large stable comic lines below his face.
6–8s: heroic full-body tableau. A single crumpled paper ball floats down onto the closed book. He unfolds it just enough to see a blank page, looks directly at the viewer with an exhausted unimpressed face, and tucks it away. No extra text. Strong readable title, cape-like dashiki settles. SFX: hard book snap, unfolding-paper thunder, fire rush and rocky rumble braided together, enormous collision, book clap, tiny final paper crinkle.
